Advising

Sign up for personalized advising

Are you navigating the challenging journey of college or medical school? Dr. Moss is a first-generation medical student who persevered through obstacles, including a stumble with Step 1 and a leave of absence, so she understands the challenges you may face.

Specialized support

Strategize your medical school or residency applications, navigate medical education as a low-income, first-generation student, and build study strategies that hold up. She brings insight into mental health and wellness to all of it.

Compassionate guidance

Living with invisible disabilities herself, Dr. Moss keeps her advising inclusive, so your own challenges are understood and supported.

Stephanie Moss, MD. Psychiatry resident physician, educator, and creator of Life as a Patient-Doctor. Helping premeds, medical students, and residents navigate the hidden curriculum, disability, exams, and residency applications.
